description.zh: 对Object名字进行分组的字符。所有Object名字包含指定的前缀，第一次出现delimiter字符之间的Object作为一组元素（即CommonPrefixes）。
description.en: The character used to group object names. All objects whose names contain the specified prefix and between which the delimiter character appears for the first time are grouped as a single element (CommonPrefixes).

description.zh:
对返回的内容进行编码并指定编码的类型。

> delimiter、marker、prefix、NextMarker以及Key使用UTF-8字符。如果delimiter、marker、prefix、NextMarker以及Key中包含XML 1.0标准不支持的控制字符，您可以通过指定encoding-type对返回结果中的Delimiter、Marker、Prefix、NextMarker以及Key进行编码。
description.en:
The encoding type of the content in the response.

> The delimiter, marker, prefix, NextMarker, and Key values use UTF-8 encoding. If the delimiter, marker, prefix, NextMarker, or Key value contains control characters that are not supported by XML 1.0, you can specify encoding-type to encode the Delimiter, Marker, Prefix, NextMarker, and Key values in the response.

description.zh:
设定从marker之后按字母排序开始返回Object。
marker用来实现分页显示效果，参数的长度必须小于1024字节。
做条件查询时，即使marker在列表中不存在，也会从符合marker字母排序的下一个开始打印。
description.en:
Specifies the object after which the listing begins in alphabetical order.
The marker parameter is used to implement pagination. The value of this parameter must be less than 1,024 bytes in length.
When performing a conditional query, even if the marker does not exist in the list, the listing starts from the next object that follows the marker in alphabetical order.

description.zh:
指定返回Object的最大数。 如果因为max-keys的设定无法一次完成列举，返回结果会附加NextMarker元素作为下一次列举的marker。
取值：大于0小于1000
默认值：100
description.en:
The maximum number of objects to return. If the listing cannot be completed at one time because of the max-keys setting, a NextMarker element is included in the response as the marker for the next listing.
Valid values: greater than 0 and less than 1000.
Default value: 100.

description.zh:
限定返回文件的Key必须以prefix作为前缀。 - prefix参数的长度必须小于1024字节。 - 使用prefix查询时，返回的Key中仍会包含prefix。 如果把prefix设为某个文件夹名，则列举以此Prefix开头的文件，即该文件夹下递归的所有文件和子文件夹。
在设置prefix的基础上，将delimiter设置为正斜线（/）时，返回值中只列举该文件夹下的文件，文件夹下的子文件夹名返回在CommonPrefixes中，子文件夹下递归的所有文件和文件夹不显示。
例如，一个Bucket中有三个Object ，分别为fun/test.jpg、 fun/movie/001.avi和fun/movie/007.avi。如果设定prefix为fun/，则返回三个Object；如果在prefix设置为fun/的基础上，将delimiter设置为正斜线（/），则返回fun/test.jpg和fun/movie/。
description.en:
Specifies that only objects whose keys start with the prefix are returned. - The prefix parameter must be less than 1,024 bytes in length. - If you use a prefix for the query, the returned keys still contain the prefix. If you set the prefix to a folder name, all objects that start with this prefix are listed, including all objects and subfolders in the folder recursively.
If you also set the delimiter to a forward slash (/), only the objects in the folder are listed. The subfolders in the folder are returned in CommonPrefixes, and the objects and folders in the subfolders recursively are not displayed.
For example, a bucket contains three objects: fun/test.jpg, fun/movie/001.avi, and fun/movie/007.avi. If you set the prefix to fun/, all three objects are returned. If you set the prefix to fun/ and the delimiter to a forward slash (/), fun/test.jpg and fun/movie/ are returned.

title.zh: 列举存储空间中所有文件的信息
title.en: List information about all objects in a bucket

descriptions.zh:
- GetBucket (ListObjects)接口已修订为GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2)。建议您在开发应用程序时使用较新的版本GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2)。为保证向后兼容性，OSS继续支持GetBucket (ListObjects)。有关GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2)的更多信息，请参见[GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2)](~~187544~~)。

- 执行GetBucket (ListObjects)请求时不会返回Object中自定义的元信息。
descriptions.en:
- The GetBucket (ListObjects) operation has been revised to GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2). Use the newer version GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2) when developing applications. For backward compatibility, Object Storage Service (OSS) continues to support GetBucket (ListObjects). For more information about GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2), see [GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2)](~~187544~~).

- A GetBucket (ListObjects) request does not return user metadata of objects.
